population.sampling: frozen salted SHA256 original user/item/date rank, without outcomes
population.population: exact prepared SFT development targets; first active date per user; tied targets retained before cap

complete_prefix.population: complete raw date<Aug9 prefix, once per distinct evaluated user

uncertainty.limitations: descriptive sampling uncertainty on reused development users; excludes model/metadata/label uncertainty and selection bias

full_raw_fit_controls.purpose: strong analytic controls; serialized baselines separately preserve sampled RM-fit scorer parity

facade_provenance_timestamp.reason: runtime generation timestamp; source bytes, rules, evidence, schema and every other provenance field remain exact

segment_support_definition: serialized sampled RM-fit target counts; full/raw zero support sets checked equal

clocks.history: BOS plus last63 raw rows strictly before 2021-08-09
clocks.past_history_outcomes: raw observations before Aug9; strict last-watch-date availability assumption

limitations: SFT development labels are reused; this is not an untouched test
observed user-item last-watch pairs and aggregated watched_pct, not causal or impression reward
retrospective static metadata has unverified historical availability
raw same-day order is arbitrary and no same-day target enters the prefix
uncalibrated scorer outputs are clipped to [0,1]; cold items always use frozen fit global mean
only the already selected saved model is evaluated; discarded candidates are unavailable
